8: Steal Barton's Scouting Report by pickpocketing it from him. Then, bring the report to Myrokos Silentform at Ravenholdt Manor.

objective.english: Steal Barton's Scouting Report by pickpocketing it from him. Then, bring the report to Myrokos Silentform at Ravenholdt Manor.

detail.english:
We have noticed a Syndicate scouting party prowling around the ruins of Alterac, led by a man named Barton.

They're clearly searching for something, but I cannot know what without reading his scouting reports.

I ask that you pickpocket the report from him, rather than killing him outright. Barton's death will tip off the Syndicate that we're on to them, and they will certainly take counter-measures to cover their tracks.

If you hope to find him, he is most likely among the Syndicate at Strahnbrad.

progress.english: What are they after in those ruins, I wonder?

complete.english: It appears you've some light fingers on you, <name>. Very good.

8: Find the Blade of House Perenolde and the Royal Aegis of Perenolde among the ruins of Alterac. Then, bring them to Myrokos Silentform.

objective.english: Find the Blade of House Perenolde and the Royal Aegis of Perenolde among the ruins of Alterac. Then, bring them to Myrokos Silentform.

detail.english:
It seems our friend Barton here has made this very easy for us. He is after two heirlooms of the Perenolde family within the ruins of Alterac. The Blade of House Perenolde, a sword, and the Royal Aegis of Perenolde, a shield.

From the report, it seems these armaments are within two towers among the ruins. Best we acquire them before the Syndicate does.

The ogres occupying the ruins are fierce, but I trust you should be able to sneak past them without needing to bloody your blade at all.

progress.english: Odds are we shall have those heirlooms before Barton even notices his reports are missing.

complete.english:
Excellent. I will hold these in safekeeping, for now, while I decide what best to do with them.

You are dismissed, <name>. Good work.

objective.english: Steal a Syndicate uniform from Northfold Manor to infiltrate Stromgarde Keep.

detail.english:
Stromgarde Keep is one of the Syndicate's largest strongholds. Many of the organization's most important dealings take place behind its walls.

I have received word of a certain trade taking place between members of the Syndicate somewhere in Arathi Highlands, and I'm certain the details of this trade can be found somewhere in Stromgarde.

To infiltrate the keep without arousing suspicion, you'll need a disguise. See if you can find one among the Syndicate outside the keep, at Northfold Manor.

objective.english: Bring 1 Jade and the Bolt Charged Bramble to Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.

detail.english:
The building of a mage's wand is not easy.  Rare substances are required, and a vessel must be made that can store great quantities of magical energy.  You must gather these things and bring them to me.

I have written onto this parchment that which you need, and instructions on how to get it.  Bring me exactly what is on this list, and follow my written directions to the letter, for if you do not then when we make your wand things might go... badly.

Aha!  You got the jade and made the bramble!  Well done!

Is that smoke I see rising from your ears?  You might have gotten too close when the lightning struck the totem sticks, but don't worry.  Being hit by lightning is good luck!

8: Speak with Magus Tirth in the Shimmering Flats.

objective.english: Speak with Magus Tirth in the Shimmering Flats.

detail.english:
To make your wand, there are key passages in a certain book that I must read.  The book is called Rituals of Power, written by the Magus Tirth.

I do not have a copy of his book, and none of the world's great libraries possess it.  So you must speak with Tirth and gain it from him.

Good luck.  Tirth used to be a great mage and scholar, but now he spends his time at the gnome and goblin races in the Shimmering Flats, drinking and gambling.

complete.english:
What?  Speak up!  These old ears aren't as sharp as they used to be.

Well, I hope you're here with a fresh mug of ale or some hot tips on the next race!  If not, then you best keep walking... because I have a polymorph wand with your name on it!

8: Find the phrase to Tirth's strongbox, then return to Tirth.

objective.english: Find the phrase to Tirth's strongbox, then return to Tirth.

detail.english:
I can help you with the book, but first you have to help me!

The tome you seek is in my magically locked strongbox.  To open it a special phrase must be uttered, and I can't remember the phrase!  Normally my assistant helps me remember these things but he's nowhere to be found.

If you want my book, then find my apprentice!  Ask around the race track--if you're lucky then someone has seen him.  Either drag him back here, or at least get my magic phrase from him so we can open my box!

progress.english: What are you waiting for?  I need my magic phrase!

complete.english:
Ah, now I remember...

I had forgotten about that little curse I put on Johnson.  I can't remember why I did it but I'm sure it served him right, the little ingrate!

objective.english: Kill Big Will, then speak to Klannoc Macleod on Fray Island.

detail.english:
If you want to learn from me, then you must first pass The Affray.  It is a challenge we on Fray Island like to offer rising warriors who think they're tough, and if you can pass this test then I'll know you are.

To begin, walk into the middle of that crowd yonder and step on the grate.  That'll tell Twiggy Flathead you're ready, and he'll send challengers against you.

Beat all the challengers and he'll call out Big Will.  Kill Big Will, and return to me in the time we allow.

You are a worthy <class>, and I am honored to teach you...

8: Bring the items on Bath'rah's Parchment to Bath'rah the Windwatcher in Alterac.

objective.english: Bring the items on Bath'rah's Parchment to Bath'rah the Windwatcher in Alterac.

detail.english:
I have spent ages watching this site.  I watch, so that one day I might see the great Cyclonian fall.  But I have not yet found a champion to defeat the wind lord.

Perhaps you are that champion.

Prove it to me.  Gather the items I need to summon Cyclonian, and I will know you are a great warrior.  Perhaps then you can defeat him and gain his whirlwind heart.

If so, then I will infuse the heart's power in a weapon, and I will give that weapon to you.

Here is a parchment with the items I need.

complete.english:
You have gathered the items for my spell, and have shown me your strength and cunning.  But the next stage of our quest is even more perilous.

Let us hope your strength does not falter.
